role: Declares the scheduled block update API: the immediate-updates and fallInstantly flags, scheduleBlockUpdate, the liquid tick rates, the NextTickListEntry struct and the pending set's reset, load, peek, pop, walk, chunk query and save/restore.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
the entry id counter is one per environment shared by every world, as NextTickListEntry.nextTickEntryID is static
line 68, ticks_walk: callback over the set
notes: struct ticks_set is one world's pending set with the world values func_147454_a reads (a replay keeps one per dimension, ticks_use picks the current); struct ticks_env is the environment's part (env.h): the current set, the nextTickEntryID counter and the probe Random.
